errors.title: Unexpected backend failure
errors.message: The backend encountered an unexpected failure.
errors.action: Preserve the diagnostic record and restart the affected worker.

errors.title: External engine launch failed
errors.message: A configured external engine could not be started or completed.
errors.action: Review engine discovery and process diagnostics before retrying.

errors.title: External engine trust failure
errors.message: The external engine or adapter failed integrity or trust verification.
errors.action: Do not execute the engine; restore a trusted signed installation.

errors.title: Design import failed
errors.message: The source design could not be converted into the canonical import contract.
errors.action: Review the source path, format hint, and importer diagnostics, then retry.

errors.title: MCAD assembly import failed
errors.message: The STEP or glTF artifact could not be safely attached to the SPIKE project.
errors.action: Save the project, verify the MCAD file and embedded resources, then retry the import.

errors.title: Import quality warning
errors.message: The design imported with incomplete or ambiguous source data.
errors.action: Review the import-quality report before configuring an analysis.

errors.title: Invalid worker request
errors.message: The backend received a request that does not satisfy the worker contract.
errors.action: Correct the request payload and retry.

errors.title: Unknown worker method
errors.message: The requested worker method is not supported by this backend version.
errors.action: Verify frontend and backend versions and use a supported method.

errors.title: Conductor mesh escaped source geometry
errors.message: A field-solver conductor volume is outside its canonical track, zone, pad, or via owner.
errors.action: Inspect the identified source geometry and mesh settings; do not solve until ownership validation passes.

errors.title: Pad drill consumes copper land
errors.message: A drilled pad has no positive annular copper region because its drill is as large as or larger than the pad land.
errors.action: Correct the pad or drill dimensions in the source design and re-import before meshing.

errors.title: Via transition geometry is unsupported
errors.message: A via type, span, land, plating, or explicit antipad cannot enter the exact circular transition contract.
errors.action: Provide supported circular source geometry and explicit reference-plane antipads, then rebuild the transition.

errors.title: Via transition discrete topology is invalid
errors.message: A circular transition mesh failed provenance, resource, orientation, manifold, or reference-void validation.
errors.action: Inspect the source-bound transition and use a supported bounded radial tessellation before solver handoff.

errors.title: Native via transition handoff was rejected
errors.message: A source-bound via transition failed the strict native geometry admission boundary.
errors.action: Rebuild and validate the transition geometry and mesh before native handoff.

errors.title: Via transition mesh quality gate failed
errors.message: A native-admitted transition failed exact geometry quality or bounded domain-convergence policy.
errors.action: Inspect the per-level geometry errors and conditioning warnings, then refine or repair the source transition.

errors.title: Reference plane antipad geometry is unsupported
errors.message: A complete source reference zone or explicit antipad failed the bounded exact geometry contract.
errors.action: Repair the source zone or antipad ownership and use an admitted bounded topology before meshing.

errors.title: Reference plane antipad mesh is invalid
errors.message: A complete source-zone mesh failed constrained-boundary, antipad-void, resource, or closed-topology validation.
errors.action: Inspect the source-bound plane and rebuild it with an admitted deterministic tessellation policy.

errors.title: Native reference plane antipad handoff was rejected
errors.message: A complete source-bound reference-plane antipad mesh failed the strict native geometry admission boundary.
errors.action: Rebuild and validate the complete reference-plane geometry and mesh before native handoff.

errors.title: Reference plane antipad mesh quality gate failed
errors.message: A native-admitted complete reference-plane mesh failed exact discrete-geometry quality or bounded domain-convergence policy.
errors.action: Inspect per-level geometry discrepancies, clearance, and conditioning, then refine or repair the source plane.

errors.title: General reference plane topology is invalid
errors.message: A concave source plane, source cutout, or explicit antipad failed exact-grid topology, separation, identity, or resource admission.
errors.action: Repair touching, crossing, nested, off-grid, or unsupported curved source boundaries before meshing.

errors.title: Bounded curve plane topology is invalid
errors.message: A SpiDeR line or circular-arc boundary failed deterministic flattening, grid, curve-envelope separation, topology, identity, or resource admission.
errors.action: Repair the source curve or increase physical separation; fixed production geometry limits are not silently relaxed.

errors.title: General reference plane mesh is invalid
errors.message: A generalized exact-grid plane mesh failed constraint, cutout, antipad, extrusion, cancellation, resource, or closed-topology admission.
errors.action: Repair the source constraints or use an admitted bounded tessellation and resource policy before native handoff.

errors.title: Native generalized plane handoff was rejected
errors.message: A generalized source-bound plane mesh failed native digest, loop, surface-role, ownership, resource, or closed-orientation admission.
errors.action: Regenerate the generalized mesh and repair incomplete loops or provenance before native handoff.

errors.title: Generalized plane mesh quality gate failed
errors.message: A generalized native-admitted plane failed deterministic antipad geometry convergence, conditioning, cancellation, or resource policy.
errors.action: Inspect the refinement series and repair source constraints or conditioning before field qualification.

errors.title: Custom pad resolved geometry is unsupported
errors.message: A custom pad lacks an admitted resolved boundary/drill combination or failed contained mesh generation.
errors.action: Use an admitted filled boundary with no drill or one centered contained plated circle/oval drill.

errors.title: Board mesh ownership accounting failed
errors.message: A supplied conductor volume escaped its canonical owner, source accounting was incomplete, or the ownership resource/cancellation contract was not satisfied.
errors.action: Inspect the source, net scope, omitted/unsupported records, and resource limits; do not hand the mesh to a solver until the ownership sidecar passes.

errors.title: Zone-pad connection evidence failed
errors.message: Retained pad, footprint, or zone policy could not be resolved against digest-bound source-filled copper evidence.
errors.action: Repair the retained connection policy or source-filled geometry; do not infer or regenerate thermal spokes.

errors.title: Thermal boundary-contact evidence failed
errors.message: A retained thermal-policy candidate could not be observed on a bounded polygonal pad boundary or failed digest, provenance, cancellation, or resource admission.
errors.action: Repair source-filled component provenance or pad geometry; do not label boundary intervals as thermal spokes.

errors.title: Observed thermal topology failed
errors.message: A controlled source-filled attachment profile failed component, width, gap, reservoir, angle, digest, cancellation, or resource admission.
errors.action: Repair the controlled fixture geometry or retained thermal parameters; do not treat observed topology as refill provenance.

errors.title: Mesh resource budget exceeded
errors.message: The requested mesh exceeds the configured time or memory budget.
errors.action: Increase the approved budget or use a coarser validated mesh policy.

errors.title: Mesh validity warning
errors.message: The generated mesh contains a condition that may limit result validity.
errors.action: Inspect the mesh diagnostics and refine the affected geometry or settings.

errors.title: Copper polygon is unusable
errors.message: A copper boundary was not admitted: it may be empty, genuinely self-intersecting, unsupported, or beyond the mesher limits.
errors.action: Check application and worker versions and inspect the identified source zone and mesh diagnostics. Older meshers reject valid KiCad filled holes joined by zero-width cuts; do not remove holes or alter valid copper to silence the warning.

errors.title: Pad geometry approximated
errors.message: A pad shape is represented by extracted bounding dimensions instead of its exact polygon.
errors.action: Inspect the identified pad in the mesh preview and use a polygon-preserving import path when exact geometry is required.

errors.title: Copper geometry skipped
errors.message: A copper primitive has invalid or unusable dimensions and was excluded from the mesh.
errors.action: Inspect the identified copper object, repair its dimensions in the source design, and re-import before solving.

errors.title: Project package invalid
errors.message: The project package is corrupt, incomplete, or incompatible.
errors.action: Open a verified backup or re-import the source design.

errors.title: Project package write failed
errors.message: The project could not be written as a verified SPIKE package.
errors.action: Choose a writable destination, verify available space, and retry.

errors.title: Terminal is not mapped to copper
errors.message: A source or load terminal could not be mapped to the selected connected conductor geometry.
errors.action: Select a pad, via, zone, or exact coordinate on the analyzed net and assign that object as the terminal anchor.

errors.title: PI formulation is unsupported
errors.message: The selected PI solver does not support the requested analysis mode or formulation.
errors.action: Select a compatible DC, AC, transient, or circuit formulation and validate the setup again.

errors.title: PI terminals are incomplete
errors.message: The PI request does not contain the source and load terminals required by the selected formulation.
errors.action: Assign at least one source and one load to exact copper objects, then validate the setup again.

errors.title: Analyzed copper geometry is empty
errors.message: No usable connected copper geometry matched the managed nets in the PI request.
errors.action: Review the managed nets, import diagnostics, layer visibility, and mesh preview before retrying.

errors.title: Load is disconnected from its source
errors.message: At least one load terminal is not electrically reachable from any configured source terminal.
errors.action: Correct terminal anchors or add the missing series-component and cross-net path definitions.

errors.title: Source boundary conflict
errors.message: Two source definitions assign different voltages to the same connected conductor node.
errors.action: Remove the duplicate source or separate the conflicting source boundaries onto distinct conductor domains.

errors.title: PDN candidate invalid
errors.message: A decoupling candidate has invalid, unreviewed, or incompatible electrical placement data.
errors.action: Review the candidate values, endpoint mapping, frequency grid, and extraction provenance.

errors.title: PDN candidate port extraction failed
errors.message: PDN candidate ports could not be extracted or mapped from terminals to the mesh.
errors.action: Review explicit source, observation, and candidate terminals, then correct their mesh mapping and retry.

errors.title: Invalid source current limit
errors.message: Source capacity must be finite and positive in amperes.
errors.action: Enter a positive number or omit current_limit_a for an unlimited ideal source.

errors.title: Source capacity unsupported
errors.message: The solver or mode cannot enforce source capacity feasibility.
errors.action: Select DC resistive-network analysis or explicitly remove the capacity requirement.

errors.title: Source capacity exceeded
errors.message: The prescribed-voltage operating point exceeds source capacity.
errors.action: Reduce demand or increase reviewed source capacity; a CV/CC operating point is not computed.

errors.title: Source current allocation unsupported
errors.message: Shared ideal source boundaries or reverse current prevent capacity admission.
errors.action: Provide distinct resistive source contacts for sharing or a qualified reverse-flow model.

errors.title: PI engineering request invalid
errors.message: A PI engineering operation received invalid transport fields.
errors.action: Supply only the documented request and, for copper routing, design fields.

errors.title: PI engineering model admission failed
errors.message: Converter or capacitor model inputs are malformed or outside the supported numerical envelope.
errors.action: Review the kernel diagnostic and correct explicit model values, topology, ratings and resource bounds.

errors.title: Explicit return path solved
errors.message: The PI solve includes explicit supply and return conductors in the paired current loop.
errors.action: No action is required.

errors.title: PDN candidate port limit exceeded
errors.message: The requested PDN candidate ports exceed the configured extraction resource limit.
errors.action: Reduce the candidate count, run bounded batches, or raise the approved limit up to the hard maximum.

errors.title: Floating copper excluded
errors.message: Copper outside the source-driven connected component was excluded from this result.
errors.action: Inspect the excluded geometry and add missing connectivity or terminals when it belongs to the intended current path.

errors.title: Voltage-drop limit exceeded
errors.message: The solved voltage drop exceeds the configured design limit.
errors.action: Inspect the highlighted path, conductor geometry, contacts, and load definition before changing the limit.

errors.title: Current-density limit exceeded
errors.message: The solved conductor current density exceeds the configured design limit.
errors.action: Inspect the identified conductor or via, then increase copper cross-section or reduce current where required.

errors.title: Copper discretization requires convergence review
errors.message: The result uses a discretized copper representation that has not passed the configured mesh-convergence policy.
errors.action: Run the convergence study and review coarse-to-fine result agreement before engineering sign-off.

errors.title: Ideal terminal package model used
errors.message: One or more source or load terminals use an ideal zero-resistance package or contact model.
errors.action: Assign measured or reviewed package and contact resistance models to the affected terminals.

errors.title: Isolated secondary simplified
errors.message: An isolated secondary is represented as a local DC boundary without transformer magnetic behavior.
errors.action: Assign a coupled transformer or circuit model when leakage, saturation, loss, or regulation must be included.

errors.title: PDN multiport approximation
errors.message: PDN multiport extraction uses a shared ideal reference; return-path and differential PCB physics are not validated.
errors.action: Use the result for screening only; obtain an independently validated power/return extraction for return-path or differential analysis.

errors.title: Report generation failed
errors.message: The engineering report could not be generated.
errors.action: Review the report diagnostics and retry with a writable destination.

errors.title: Solver unavailable
errors.message: No installed solver satisfies the requested capability and validity policy.
errors.action: Select or install an eligible solver and validate the setup again.

errors.title: Solver failed to converge
errors.message: The solver did not converge within its declared numerical limits.
errors.action: Review conditioning and mesh diagnostics before changing solver limits.

errors.title: Solver execution cancelled
errors.message: The active solver or co-simulation was cancelled before it completed.
errors.action: Review any partial diagnostics, then run the analysis again when ready.

errors.title: Solver progress
errors.message: The solver reported a progress update.
errors.action: No action is required.

errors.title: Solver time budget exceeded
errors.message: The active solver or co-simulation exceeded its configured wall-time budget.
errors.action: Increase the approved time budget or reduce the validated model complexity.

errors.title: Interactive result data decimated
errors.message: Interactive geometry or result records were reduced to remain within the configured display budget.
errors.action: Increase the approved result-detail budget for full export, or keep decimation enabled for responsive inspection.

errors.title: Linear residual is elevated
errors.message: The solved linear system has a scaled residual above the preferred engineering threshold.
errors.action: Review disconnected geometry, resistance ratios, terminal placement, and mesh convergence before using the result.

errors.title: SPICE workspace contract invalid
errors.message: The SPICE workspace does not satisfy the supported contract.
errors.action: Correct the workspace contract and validate it again.

errors.title: SPICE model invalid
errors.message: A SPICE model definition is incomplete or invalid.
errors.action: Correct the model definition and validate the workspace again.

errors.title: SPICE assignment invalid
errors.message: A component or pin assignment is incomplete or inconsistent.
errors.action: Map every required model pin to an explicit design anchor.

errors.title: SPICE parasitic mapping invalid
errors.message: A parasitic element has invalid terminals, units, or provenance.
errors.action: Review terminal mapping, units, and extraction provenance.

errors.title: Field/circuit coupling request invalid
errors.message: The closed-loop field/circuit request, circuit stage, or convergence controls are invalid.
errors.action: Review the circuit workspace, coupling controls, and explicit terminal mappings.

errors.title: Field reduction response invalid
errors.message: The field adapter returned an invalid result or attempted to change reviewed coupling topology.
errors.action: Inspect the field adapter diagnostics and preserve the reviewed parasitic IDs and endpoints.

errors.title: PEEC field mapping invalid
errors.message: The native PEEC result could not be mapped to the reviewed circuit parasitics.
errors.action: Re-extract the PEEC network and review its explicit circuit endpoint mapping before rerunning co-simulation.

errors.title: SPIKES backend execution failed
errors.message: The structured workspace passed admission but the SPIKES backend bridge failed.
errors.action: Inspect the SPIKES backend status, workspace validation, and bounded execution diagnostics.

errors.title: SPICE transient budget exceeded
errors.message: The transient setup exceeds its configured point, time, or memory budget.
errors.action: Adjust duration, step size, outputs, or the approved resource budget.

errors.title: Unsafe SPICE content blocked
errors.message: The SPICE workspace contains content prohibited by the execution policy.
errors.action: Remove the prohibited directive or import a reviewed immutable model.

errors.title: SPICE parasitic model unvalidated
errors.message: A parasitic model is outside its validated use or frequency range.
errors.action: Use a validated extraction or explicitly limit the requested analysis.

errors.title: Board visual preparation failed
errors.message: A board layout, board scene, or component scene could not be prepared.
errors.action: Keep the completed visual stages, review the failed stage diagnostic, correct its source or local tool issue, and retry that stage.

errors.title: Unexpected frontend failure
errors.message: The application encountered an unexpected frontend failure.
errors.action: Preserve the diagnostic record and restart SPIKE.

errors.title: Frontend operation failed
errors.message: The requested frontend operation could not be completed.
errors.action: Review the operation details, correct the input, and retry.

errors.title: Operation status
errors.message: The requested frontend operation reported a status update.
errors.action: No action is required.

errors.title: Frontend operation warning
errors.message: The frontend completed an operation with a condition that requires review.
errors.action: Review the associated object and suggested recovery before continuing.

errors.title: Worker unavailable
errors.message: The frontend could not communicate with the local analysis worker.
errors.action: Restart the worker or the application, then retry the operation.

errors.title: Malformed worker response
errors.message: The worker returned a response that does not satisfy its contract.
errors.action: Preserve the diagnostic record and verify component versions.

errors.title: Project open failed
errors.message: The selected project could not be opened by the frontend.
errors.action: Check the project path and package integrity, then retry.

errors.title: SPICE assistant input invalid
errors.message: The SPICE model assistant contains invalid or incomplete input.
errors.action: Correct the highlighted model, pin, or analysis fields and validate again.

errors.title: Assembly display model could not be loaded
errors.message: A board or visual-stage display model could not be loaded; retained procedural geometry remains usable.
errors.action: Reopen the project, repair model assignments in the 3D Model Manager, and retry visual preparation.

errors.title: WebGL context lost
errors.message: The renderer suspended drawing after its WebGL context was lost and will resume if restoration succeeds.
errors.action: Close other GPU-heavy applications, lower rendering quality, and reopen the workspace if rendering does not restore.

errors.title: Viewport performance degraded
errors.message: The viewport exceeded its configured frame-time budget.
errors.action: Reduce visible detail or select a lower rendering quality preset.

    parallel-pool       Report bounded CPU pool and actual accelerator
                        backends
    parallel-run        Run reviewed inline independent analysis jobs
                        concurrently
    cluster-probe       Contact only explicitly enrolled mutual-TLS worker
                        nodes
    cluster-run         Contact only explicitly enrolled mutual-TLS worker
                        nodes
    cluster-serve       Serve an explicitly trusted node; binds loopback
                        unless configured
    cluster-discover    List inert LAN hints; never enroll or execute
    cluster-fingerprint
                        Print a public certificate SHA256 fingerprint for
                        enrollment
    worker-call         Run any registered worker operation without the GUI;
                        explicit writes retain worker admission
    workflow            Run a bounded JSON workflow with prior-step
                        references; stop on failure, no rollback
    capabilities        Show worker and analysis capabilities
    capability-ledger   Show native ownership, validation, and release gates
                        for every workflow
    assistant-tools     Emit the exact allowlisted MCP tool catalog and input
                        schemas for local assistants
    project-inspect     Inspect a SPIKE v3 package or supported legacy project
                        without extracting it
    project-migrate     Migrate a legacy SPIKE JSON project into a secure v3
                        package
    solvers             List solver plugins and validity limits
    extensions          List installed extension modules
    accelerators        List optional numerical acceleration backends and
                        selection policy
    external-engines    List optional external engineering engines and adapter
                        readiness
    solver-manager      Show workload recommendations, registrations, tuning,
                        and execution gates
    sparselizard-runtime-status
                        Verify the integrity-bound native sparseLizard runtime
                        without enabling PCB solver capabilities
    sparselizard-validation-status
                        Evaluate signed-runtime, PETSc/MUMPS, convergence, and
                        PCB fixture release gates
    solver-recommend    Recommend the best currently runnable solver for a
                        workload
    solver-register     Register an explicit local external-engine path
                        without installing it
    solver-unregister   Forget an external-engine registration without
                        deleting its files
    solver-tune         Save allowlisted, range-checked solver tuning values
    dependencies        Verify the bundled dependency lock
    benchmark           Run analytical, convergence, and native solver
                        benchmarks
    pi-release-qualification
                        Fail closed unless the packaged runtime and all stable
                        PI workflow gates pass
    openems-benchmark   Run the real openEMS simple-patch reference and mesh-
                        convergence gate
    environment-list    List built-in cross-domain environment profiles
    environment-materialize
                        Materialize a built-in preset or a user-owned
                        environment profile
    environment-validate
                        Validate environment input readiness for one or more
                        solver domains
    import (import-design)
                        Normalize an EDA design into SpiDeR
    validate            Validate a design or SPIKE project
    inspect             Inspect normalized design content
    extract-net         Export complete geometry for one net
    analyze-dc (dc)     Build and run a DC PI request
    setup-dc            Build a reproducible DC PI request without running it
    analyze-ac (ac)     Build and run a hybrid PEEC R/L/C/G request
    setup-ac            Build a reproducible AC PEEC request without running
                        it
    analyze-transient (transient)
                        Run a geometry-derived quasi-static PEEC RLC transient
    setup-transient     Build a reproducible quasi-static PEEC RLC transient
                        request without running it
    preflight           Validate an analysis request and generate its pre-
                        solve mesh
    mesh-preview        Generate a pre-solve mesh from an analysis request
    converge            Run coarse-to-fine PI mesh convergence from an
                        analysis request
    run                 Execute an analysis request, batch manifest, or SPIKE
                        project
    emi-preflight       Validate a versioned EMI setup without running field
                        physics
    emi-screen          Rank EMI review nets from supplied pre-pass metrics
    openems-prepare     Prepare an inspectable openEMS case from an analysis
                        request
    openems-run         Build or execute a prepared SPIKE openEMS case
    sparselizard-prepare
                        Prepare a reviewed differential-port PI multiport case
                        for sparseLizard
    sparselizard-run    Execute a prepared case through an exact spike-
                        sparselizard-adapter executable
    report              Generate a report from an AnalysisResult JSON file
    compare             Compare two AnalysisResult files
    pdn-network         Solve an explicit lumped PI network: AC impedance and
                        optional load transient
    rlgc-cascade        Solve a supplied piecewise RLGC line, local fields and
                        section losses
    rlgc-junction       Solve supplied RLGC star legs, coherent fields and
                        distributed losses
    rlgc-coupled-pair   Solve supplied symmetric coupled pair, coherent
                        conductor fields and pair losses
    rlgc-terminated-pair
                        Load a supplied coupled pair with physical resistive
                        sources and retain terminal/line heat
    rlgc-loaded-star    Drive a supplied coupled star with physical RLC
                        sources and loads; retain branch fields and separate
                        heat and storage
    rlgc-coupled-star   Connect supplied coupled legs at two ideal conductor
                        nodes; retain branch fields and heat
    rlgc-loaded-cascade
                        Drive a supplied coupled cascade with physical R/L/C
                        sources and loads; retain fields, heat and mean stored
                        energy
    rlgc-coupled-cascade
                        Connect supplied coupled-line sections with ideal
                        interfaces; retain section fields and heat
    rlgc-reactive-pair  Load a supplied coupled pair with series R/L and shunt
                        C; retain heat, reactive power and stored energy
                        separately
    pdn-review          Check an AC result against a PDN target and screen
                        lumped decoupling candidates
    pdn-optimize        Search explicit capacitor ports and a finite component
                        library using a PDN multiport result
    external-pi-import  Validate and normalize an external PI multiport result
                        for PDN analysis
    peec-spice-import   Import reviewed PEEC RLCG networks into a visual SPICE
                        workspace
    hybrid-run          Run reviewed PEEC RLCG plus explicit component models
                        through ngspice
    native-mna-validate
                        Validate a versioned native linear MNA circuit request
                        without solving it
    native-mna-run      Run a versioned native linear MNA DC, AC, or transient
                        circuit request
    native-workspace-compile
                        Compile a reviewed visual SPICE workspace into the
                        native linear MNA contract
    native-workspace-run
                        Compile and run a reviewed visual SPICE workspace with
                        the native linear MNA engine
    em-machine          Run a bounded PM motor, generator or single-gap
                        electromagnet model
    magnetic-machine    Run experimental planar machine/actuator magnetic FEM
    assembly-em         Execute explicit retained-volume assembly EM with
                        OpenEMS
    engineering-review  Run a read-only engineering review or explicit SI-unit
                        calculator
    quick-tool          Run a read-only engineering review or explicit SI-unit
                        calculator
    cosimulation-catalog
                        Describe experimental co-simulation and recorded twin
                        support
    cosimulation-run    Run an offline versioned request
    digital-twin-compare
                        Run an offline versioned request
    field-circuit-validate
                        Fail-closed validation for a reviewed SpiDeR, SPICE
                        workspace, and PEEC field-circuit package
    field-circuit-run   Run a reviewed field-circuit co-simulation through the
                        native PEEC reduction provider
    converter-study     Run a reviewed PWM converter study through ngspice,
                        optional PEEC, analytics, and thermal handoff
    thermal-estimate    Run the explicit first-order compact thermal RC

    sparam-inspect (touchstone)
                        Inspect Touchstone data, network traces, and validity

    sparam-renormalize  Convert a Touchstone network to a new real reference

    si-geometry-channel
                        Run the bounded straight SpiDeR v2 geometry-to-

    si-candidate-study  Compare explicit supplied-line SI candidates and
                        corners (experimental)
